name: Stride
tagline: Run your consultancy on intelligence, not instinct.
oneLiner: The AI-powered operating system for education consultancies.
description: Stride is the AI-powered operating system for education consultancies. It brings every part of the business — leads, admissions, classes and attendance, IELTS/PTE mock tests, AI mock interviews, SOPs and CVs, scholarships, HR and payroll — into one system, and turns that data into decisions: which lead to call next, which student is falling behind, which branch needs help. Built for consultancies that want to run like the best in the world.
